content: Photo storage best practice for small apps: resize/compress client-side before upload (Canvas API toBlob or browser-image-compression) and generate one canonical thumbnail server-side at upload time; do not store original multi-MB phone photos or many size variants. Server-side validation is still needed because client-side resizing can be bypassed; EXIF orientation should be stripped/handled. Sources: Stack Overflow, SE StackExchange, Reddit r/webdev, ProcessWire forums.
